text: At the extraction landing, nsMsgFilter.cpp places nsMsgFilter.h first, then mozilla/Components.h and mozilla/intl/AppDateTimeFormat.h before msgCore.h and the remaining ordered includes. This is a scoped accepted organization for the affected C++ include group. Current source retains that prefix but has a later Localization include at the end, so it does not support a claim that the whole current file is alphabetically sorted or a repository-wide include rule. The historical first comment also misspells nsIMsgFilter; no unrelated rewrite or deliberate instruction change is made. No formatter or build ran.
title: The filter extraction puts its own header first and mozilla includes before msgCore
